items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Peek-a-boo Jimmy in the context of a union dispute involving Joe Thomas, but Joe Thomas does not speak or describe a personal relationship in the provided transcript.

ctx.x: No, I think Joe played piano. And we did some things around town and somehow I happened to run into Joe Jordan. Don't let me leave out Peek-a-boo Jimmy. Please don't leave him out.
